headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: India Today / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Hyderabad on high alert after LeT email threatens 26/11-style terror attack.
BRS Minority Cell General Secretary condemns Youth Congress attack on Meta office.
Tension prevails at church; parish election suspended.
People with diabetes, hypertension must undergo annual eye examinations, says Jagtial MLA.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad high alert par, LeT ki email mein 26/11 jaise dehsatgard hamlay ki dhamki.
BRS Minority Cell ke General Secretary ne Meta office par Youth Congress ke hamlay ki muzammat ki.
Church mein tanao barqarar, parish intikhabat multavi kar diye gaye.
Diabetes aur hypertension ke mareez saalana ankhon ka muyana karwayen, Jagtial MLA ka bayan.
